nodes.summary: ARACNE recovers tree networks exactly (Margolin et al. 2006, Theorem 1): if the true network `T` is a tree whose edges all carry mutual information above `I₀`, and the strict data-processing inequality holds on every separated triple, then ARACNE returns `T`. Strictness is the explicit form of the paper's exclusion of exact cancellations; with equality ARACNE can keep an indirect edge (see the tests).
nodes.title: ARACNE recovers tree networks exactly

nodes.summary: If the true network `T` is a tree and `I a b < min (I a c) (I c b)` whenever `c` separates `a` from `b` in `T`, then every edge ARACNE keeps is an edge of `T`.
nodes.title: No false positives

nodes.summary: The network ARACNE reconstructs from symmetric pairwise mutual informations `I` with independence threshold `I₀` and DPI tolerance zero (Margolin et al. 2006): `{i, k}` is an edge iff `i ≠ k`, `I₀ < I i k`, and no third gene `j` with `I₀ < I i j` and `I₀ < I j k` has `I i k < min (I i j) (I j k)`.
nodes.title: ARACNE gene network reconstruction

nodes.summary: If the true network `T` is a forest whose edges all carry mutual information above `I₀`, and `I a b ≤ min (I a c) (I c b)` whenever `c` separates `a` from `b` in `T` (every walk from `a` to `b` visits `c`), then ARACNE keeps every edge of `T`.
nodes.title: No false negatives

nodes.summary: Chow–Liu trees survive ARACNE (Margolin et al. 2006, Theorem 2): a spanning tree `T` of maximum total weight `∑_{{i, k} ∈ T} I i k` among all spanning trees, whose edges all carry mutual information above `I₀`, is a subnetwork of the ARACNE network.
nodes.title: Chow–Liu trees survive ARACNE

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
